notes: Content pack manifests (Assets/Scripts/Core/ContentPacks.cs). id = pack; regions = maps it adds content for (empty = all); dlcId = entitlement checked with Dlc.Owns; requires = packs it builds on; filePrefixes = its file prefixes in Data/Economy, Data/Loc, Data/Missions, Data/Campaigns, Data/Events, Data/Quests; comingSoon = listed but never active.
